source_issue.title: Align appVersion with Plone 6.2.2.1 and document the image update policy

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on updating the `appVersion` in our Helm charts to match the latest Plone release (6.2.2.1) and documenting our image update policy. This ensures that users are using the most secure version of the application.

## What needs to be done
1. Update the `appVersion` from 6.2.2 to 6.2.2.1 in the relevant files.
2. Document the image update policy, detailing when to use `pullPolicy: Always` versus a specific digest.
3. Explore optional `image.digest` values for better control over image versions.

## Helpful background
In Kubernetes, `pullPolicy` determines whether an image is pulled from the registry or used from the local cache. The `appVersion` reflects the version of your application, while each Docker image can be uniquely identified using a digest.

## Good first steps
1. Fork the repository and check out a new branch.
2. Locate the configuration file where `appVersion` is defined.
3. Modify the version to match 6.2.2.1.
4. Start drafting the documentation on the image update policy.
5. Once ready, submit a pull request for review.
